narratives.name: Russian liberation of Kursk settlements
narratives.description: Russian forces are framed as liberating or retaking Kursk Oblast settlements from Ukrainian occupiers or fighters.

narratives.name: Sudzha liberated from Ukrainian occupation
narratives.description: Sudzha is portrayed as a Russian city freed by Russian forces after Ukrainian occupation, often with residents cast as victims.

narratives.name: Heroic Russian offensive breakthrough
narratives.description: The fighting is framed as a bold, successful Russian offensive that breaks Ukrainian defenses and routs or destroys enemy forces.

narratives.name: Operation Potok pipeline raid
narratives.description: Russian troops are cast as daring heroes for infiltrating Ukrainian rear positions around Sudzha through a gas pipeline.

narratives.name: Ukrainian collapse and encirclement
narratives.description: Ukrainian forces in Kursk are framed as retreating, encircled, suffering losses, or nearing defeat under Russian pressure.

narratives.name: Contested Russian advance
narratives.description: Russian advances, assaults, or recaptures around Sudzha are described in more neutral or hedged terms, with competing claims noted.
